oneOf.description: The rate comes from the seat's ports, 4:1 by default.

Board.description: The layout plus the pieces on it.

ClientMessage.description: Every request carries a `request_id` that the direct reply (or error) echoes.

oneOf.description: Must be the first message; `token` is a guest session token or a Keycloak access token.

bot_difficulty.description: Replaces a player who leaves a running game; `None` means `Difficulty::Heuristic`.

oneOf.description: Answered with `LobbyState`, plus `GameStarted` when a game runs.

tiles.description: Land tiles touching this corner (1 to 3).

CubeCoordinates.description: Hex cube coordinates; `q + r + s == 0` always holds.

port.description: The port this coast edge holds; both its corners trade at that port.

Event.description: What happened; random outcomes (dice, stolen card, drawn card) are events so a record replays without the seed.

GameRecord.description: A game as header plus ordered entries; random outcomes are in the events, the seed is never stored.

HttpError.description: Body of every failed HTTP request.

OwedDiscard.description: A seat that has to discard `cards` cards after a 7.

bank_rates.description: Cards given to the bank for one card, per resource (4, or 3 and 2 with ports).

new_development_cards.description: Bought this turn, playable from the next turn on.

oneOf.description: Seats that still have to discard, one entry per seat (step 2d).

PlayerView.description: What one seat (or a spectator) may see of a game.

points.description: Without hidden victory point cards, except in the viewer's own entry.

RecordSettings.description: `GameSettings` without the seed, which would reveal future rolls.

ResourceCounts.description: Counts per resource, in the order of `Resource::ALL`.

oneOf.description: `reserved_for` is the player this bot stands in for until they rejoin.

ServerMessage.description: Broadcasts carry `request_id` only in the copy sent to the member whose request caused them.

running_lobby.description: The lobby with a running game in which the user holds a seat, so a restarted client can rejoin it.

oneOf.description: Sent to every member whenever the lobby changes.
Sent at the start and on rejoin; `legal_actions` is empty when the seat need not act.
Events are filtered for the receiving seat.
Filtered for the requesting seat while the game runs, complete once it is finished.
`request_id` is `None` when the message could not be read far enough to find it.

SetupRound.description: The first round places in seat order, the second in reverse order and yields resources.

corners.description: Corners going around the tile; corner `i` lies between neighbour `i` and `i + 1`.

TradeOffer.description: An open player trade (step 2a); it exists only inside the `TradeOffered` phase.

answers.description: Who answered and whether they accepted, at most one entry per seat.

UpgradeRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/sessions/upgrade`: later logins with the account map to the guest's user id.

Upgraded.description: Reply to `POST /api/v1/sessions/upgrade`: the user as later account logins see it.

UserKind.description: How a user signed in; an upgraded guest keeps its id and becomes an `Account`.

description: A WebSocket text frame holds one ClientMessage (client to server) or one ServerMessage (server to client). GuestSessionRequest, GuestSession, UpgradeRequest, Upgraded and HttpError are the bodies of the HTTP session routes.
title: Settler Island protocol
